configuration.tommys2.path.description: Path to the Hermes executable. Leave empty to auto-detect.
configuration.tommys2.cwd.description: Working directory for Hermes sessions. Defaults to workspace root.
configuration.tommys2.profile.descriptio: Hermes profile name (maps to hermes --profile <name>). Leave empty for default.
configuration.tommys2.showThoughts.descr: Show agent thinking process in the chat.
configuration.tommys2.showToolCalls.desc: Show tool call notifications in the chat.
configuration.tommys2.models.description: Fallback model list when Hermes does not expose ACP session config options.
configuration.tommys2.models.markdownDes:
Used when the agent does not return `configOptions` with a model selector. Example:
```json
[
  { "id": "claude-sonnet", "name": "Claude Sonnet" },
  { "id": "gpt-4o", "name": "GPT-4o" }
]
```
configuration.tommys2.defaultModel.descr: Default model id from hermes.models (fallback list only).
configuration.tommys2.agents.description: List of named agent configurations for quick switching via the chat UI.
configuration.tommys2.agents.markdownDes:
List of named agent configurations for quick switching. Each agent can have a different `path`, `profile`, and `cwd`. Example:
```json
[
  { "name": "Default", "profile": "" },
  { "name": "Fast", "path": "/path/to/hermes", "profile": "fast" }
]
```
